Manager & 
MPIS coordinator, and certified by Eng Mohamed Nageeb inspection & quality control's head sector.

A work permit
must be issued.

The maintenance staff should carry the suitable ID safety
category.

Maintenance staff
should be well trained, qualified or directly supervised by some one who is.

أمان fence with
caution marks surrounding the work area is required.

Personal protective equipment must be used as safety shoes, and safety helmet 
 .... etc

Disconnect the power supply & rack out the circuit
breaker.
Put red tag on the pump.
Close the shutoff valves in the (suction & discharge& balancing & min flow ).

Let the pumps cool down to about < 80oC measured at
the branches, then seal off the cooling water pipes and close all other supply
lines.

Loosen all auxiliary lines, such as circulation, cooling
liquid, lube oil.

The safety department must check the isolation and surrounding
the zone of work.

Disconnect the motor electrically.
Isolate the pump from suction and discharge by closing
the valves.
Drain pump casing, bearing frame and cooling circuit.
Disconnect all auxiliary circuits.
Remove coupling guard.
Remove coupling spacer to allow dismantling of the pump
with disturbing either motor or pump casing.
Loosen fixing screws on back frame foot of the pump.
Unscrew fixing nuts on stuffing box.
Remove the assembly consisting of bearing frame and
stuffing box from pump casing making use of the extracting screws specially
provided for this purpose.
